limitations: Seed 2292 uses a compatibility adapter because its legacy records contain robust distal-arm connectivity, not the modern pinch payload.
The modern full-transverse detector is checked on saved seed-2292 fields at t=1700 and 1720; no t=1710 full field was retained.
The original v1 aggregate remains immutable and mixes the older two-arm seed-2292 clock with modern one-arm clocks; it is execution history, not the corrected table.

roy_reproduction_only.definition: at least two of the same arms detached at all three thresholds for three consecutive observations
